title: Implement multi topology non linear clipping engine with equal power topology crossfade
description:
Create Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.h and Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.cpp implementing a 4-mode nonlinear clipper with click-free topology switching.

Voicing modes:
- (0) Yng-Grey: arctan(v) + gamma*v^2*exp(-|v|) with gamma=0.15
- (1) Precision Tight: symmetric tanh(v)
- (2) Asymmetric SD-1: piecewise tanh with k_pos=1.0 for v>=0 and k_neg=1.8 for v<0
- (3) Clean Attack Boost: clipping bypassed (unity passthrough)

On voicing_mode change, perform a 15 ms equal-power crossfade between the old and new topology outputs to avoid step discontinuities: run both waveshapers during the fade window and mix with equal-power (cos/sin) gains. Do not switch topology instantaneously.

Binding real-time rules: no heap allocation, locks, file IO, or string construction in the per-sample/processBlock path; instantiate juce::ScopedNoDenormals at the top of any block-processing method; allocate all state during prepare. Provide a class NonlinearClipper with prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize), reset(), setVoicingMode(int), and a process method.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/TransientShaper.h (from d.1) for the established prepare/reset/process signature conventions.
- CMakeLists.txt to understand how Source/DSP files are compiled (do not modify it here).
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp for any helper types you use (read only; do not modify JUCE/).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.h and Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.cpp exist and declare/define a NonlinearClipper class with setVoicingMode, prepare, reset, and a process method
All four voicing modes are implemented: Yng-Grey (gamma=0.15), Precision Tight (tanh), Asymmetric SD-1 (k_pos=1.0, k_neg=1.8), Clean Attack Boost (bypass)
Voicing mode changes trigger a 15 ms equal-power crossfade computed with complementary cos/sin gains, running both topologies during the fade
juce::ScopedNoDenormals is instantiated at the top of the block-processing method and no heap allocation occurs in the per-sample path
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: switch voicing topology without the 15 ms equal-power crossfade
perform heap allocation, locking, or string construction inside the per-sample processing path

allowed: add private per-mode waveshaping helper functions
store crossfade state (remaining samples, source/target mode) allocated in prepare
forbidden: change the documented gamma/k_pos/k_neg constants or fade length
